children: Caliber launched a comprehensive note exchange program to reshape its unsecured debt, enabling holders to convert into new 6% amortizing notes, exchange into Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock with registration rights, or grant a payoff option at 80% of face value. As of September 14, 2026, the company has refinanced approximately $3.4 million and secured agreements covering an additional $9.1 million of notes eligible for discounted payoff over the next six months. In total, $12.6 million of indebtedness has been converted or committed under the program, aimed at improving liquidity, reducing principal, and lowering interest expense.
Agreement 1: Caliber Launches Note Exchange, Refinances $3.4M; Option to Retire $9.1M at 80%
: Note exchange program for unsecured promissory notes
Agreement 2: Caliber Swaps $2.9 Million of Notes Into New 6% Subordinated Amortizing Notes
: Subordinated amortizing promissory notes at 6% with monthly amortization
: Stabilize maturities and lower near-term cash needs
Agreement 3: Caliber Converts $0.6 Million of Notes Into Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock
: Preferred stock subscription agreements for Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock with registration rights
Agreement 4: Caliber Secures 6-Month Right to Retire $9.1 Million of Notes at 80% of Par
: Payoff option and standstill agreements at 80% of face value
: Reduce principal outstanding and interest costs
